disagreements.finding: New exact-current finding: aggregate_experience_events canonicalizes event_id with str(event.get(...)).strip(). A literal null/None therefore becomes the non-empty identity string 'None' rather than a missing identity; bool, numeric, list, mapping and arbitrary objects are likewise string-coerced. A verified record with event_id=None can therefore be accepted and credited under a fabricated canonical identity.
disagreements.required_change: Introduce one canonical EventIdentity typed boundary before any ledger acceptance. Live/adoptable input must accept only a bounded explicit string identifier or a deterministic structured-envelope hash. None/missing/bool/numeric/list/mapping/arbitrary objects must fail closed or be bounded-rejected, never str-coerced into identity.

disagreements.finding: v1 and v2 normalize risk through str(risk).strip().upper(), while NONE is a valid low-risk value. Python None therefore becomes valid NONE instead of failing closed.
disagreements.required_change: Use one typed RiskLevel parser shared by v1/v2/v2.1; only explicit NONE/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL strings are accepted and null/missing/non-string values fail closed.

disagreements.finding: event_kind still has no single canonical typed parser across v2/v2.1: credit uses str(...).strip().upper(), v2 later calls raw event_kind.upper(), and v2.1 uses str(...).upper() without strip.
disagreements.required_change: Use one canonical EventKind parser exactly once across v2/v2.1/ledger; all credit/classification paths consume the same canonical value.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load, validate or enforce the actual fresh authority decision, so the executable does not prove that fresh authority wins.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed; conflict handling must enforce the trusted decision rather than merely suppress secretary_level.

statistical_risks: Null or non-string event identities can be silently coerced into accepted IDs, corrupting duplicate/replay denominators and longitudinal event counts.
Null/missing risk can be silently aliased to explicit NONE, creating optimistic routing bias.
EventKind parser divergence can create path-dependent classification and denial-of-evidence from non-string inputs.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and raw-field credit paths can inflate or suppress longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Caller-created operational events can inflate durable-progress numerator without proof of durable work.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.
One canonical typed EventIdentity boundary rejects null/missing/non-string IDs, binds accepted IDs to exact event/evidence/verifier lineage, and provides durable rollback-resistant replay semantics.
One canonical typed RiskLevel parser is shared by v1/v2/v2.1; None/missing/non-string values fail closed and only explicit NONE means no-risk.

One canonical typed EventKind parser is shared by v2/v2.1 and ledger; non-string/ambiguous values fail closed and whitespace/case normalization cannot produce cross-path classification or credit divergence.
Secretary signal provenance/freshness is replay-resistant and fresh authority is projected from an exact trusted authority decision, not caller booleans.
recent_shift_rate_ratio is derived from canonical shift history with precommitted denominator/sample/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; paired performance non-regression passes.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independent derivation and anti-self-reinforcement tests pass.

Accepted event identity and evidence lineage are durable and rollback-resistant; exact replay NO_OPs, same evidence/new ID cannot re-credit, same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT, and rejected claims do not reserve identity.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance receipt; v2.1 cannot re-mint verified credit from raw fields.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only and authoritative operational credit requires durable artifact/defect acceptance receipt.
Credit weights remain explicitly heuristic and are forbidden as capability/Trust/Identity/Personality/Governance truth or promotion thresholds.

Speedup requires sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover evidence on durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with frozen metric definitions, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.
Formal A->B->C is not entered until candidate vetoes are resolved; v1 verified baseline remains preserved.
